posts.title: The verifier that passed when it should have failed
My first month sending PRs into other people's code
I let an AI assistant write my tests for a week
I cut my side project in half, and people finally used it

notes: The data library's maintainer asked me to split my PR in two. I was annoyed for about an hour. The smaller half got merged the same afternoon.
Spent the evening reading the command-line tool's tests before touching anything. I understand the code better from its tests than from its README.
The verifier fix got merged after the second round of review. The maintainer said the test showing the old behavior was what convinced them.
Took two hours to get the healthcare frontend running locally. Wrote the steps down as I went and opened a docs PR with them.
First PR to the data library: a sort order that didn't match the rest of the file. Twenty minutes to write, two days to get a review.
Found the verifier bug while reading the model verification tool: with no hash on record, the check passes.
